name: Maren Taber Block-Heel Sandal
description: An open-toe block-heel sandal with architectural strap work across the vamp and ankle — wide bands of polished synth-leather in bone, black, or deep burgundy. The 6cm block heel is stable and practical. Maren Taber is a mid-luxury brand known for clean geometry. This sandal is dinner-party footwear, the kind worn by people who care about the full picture.
functionality: Adjustable strap buckles with micro-ratchet mechanism for precise fit. No active tech.
what_it_says: You have taste and the income to back it up. Social, refined, aware of how you're perceived.
story_hooks: The micro-ratchet buckle mechanism is almost identical to one used in a specific restraint device — a detail that comes up at an inconvenient moment.
Maren Taber's flagship store in the Tier 4 district is a known meeting point for a certain class of fixer.
